title: G0W0 Si k888 (database-aligned), SG15 3s3p2d, five-stage pipeline
note: Database-aligned Si G0W0. The screening grid is the SCF grid, so it must be the archived 8x8x8 (512 q-points, KPT_scf identical to si-paper-all_kpath), not the 4x4x4 used by the earlier si-k444-sg15 demo. ABACUS symmetry -1 in both SCF and NSCF, matching the archived INPUT_scf/INPUT_nscf; SG15 PP + 3s3p2d NAO + pca1e-6 ABFS with hashes identical to the database Si-SG15 set; nbands 44, ecutwfc 120, nfreq 16, minimax, n_params_anacon 6. The band path is truncated to Gamma -> 0.85(Gamma-X) where the Si CBM lies, so the comparison target is the database si-paper-all_kpath gap 1.0596 eV (paper 1.06 eV) sampled on the same segment. The head/wing must be computed by LibRPA itself: a pyatb_librpa_df/ directory is moved aside before the LibRPA stage because this binary reads its head/wing unconditionally when that directory exists, whereas the archived run computed the head term internally (head(iw=0) 14.66, versus 21.24 from the PyATB products). The cut Coulomb is checked before LibRPA and use_cholesky_gw_wc follows the definiteness result.
